reasons: Mechanism 'Real-time data synchronization' claims continuous ingestion but source only states 'continuously uses real data' without specifying real-time or sensor data ingestion architecture

Mechanism 'Predictive emulation and action prescription' attributes prescriptive capability to the twin but source only describes it as replicating to 'predict failures and opportunities' and 'prescribe real time actions' as a quoted definition, not verified mechanism
Summary states 'Originating from NASA's 2010 spacecraft simulation efforts' but source says concept originated earlier and 'first practical definition' came from NASA in 2010
Summary claims 'comprises three components' as fact but source marks this with '{{fact|date=October 2025}}' indicating citation needed
Unknowns include 'Exact architecture of the communication channel' but source explicitly names it 'digital thread' and describes it as information flows and sensor flows
